Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_WelcomeAnnounce_: Announce in chat when a player joins or returns
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_WelcomeAnnounceT: Use this text instead of the default welcome messages. Use %1 as a placeholder for the player's name, for example: Welcome to the apocalypse %1. Leave blank for the defaults.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_AnnounceAdmins_t: Untick to keep staff arrivals and departures out of chat. Covers anyone with an access level above none - admin, moderator, overseer, gm or observer - and applies to both joining and leaving.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_GoodbyeAnnouncem: Announce in chat when a player leaves
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_GoodbyeAnnounceT: Use this text instead of the default goodbye messages. Use %1 as a placeholder for the player's name, for example: Goodbye %1. Leave blank for the defaults.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_ColorUsernames_t: Highlight known usernames wherever they appear in chat
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_ColorUsernameTex: RGB values to use for highlighting instead of the default 255,255,255. Leave blank for the default.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_ReplaceMusic_too: Replace [img=music] clutter in chat with a small music note icon
Sandbox_PhunServer2Chat_ReplaceRadio_too: Replace the Radio (station): prefix with a speaker icon. Cleaner, but it does remove the station name.
